name: Composer Shell
description: Three-column workspace shell of the Composer context-engine app: left composition-stack rail, center active-layer canvas (progress hairline, active-layer header, locked-context cards, swappable layer canvas slot, composer footer, future-preview cards) and right files rail. Layer canvases hosted by the center slot are out of scope.

properties.dataContext: ComposerViewModel (MVUX bindable over Composer.Models.ComposerModel), assigned in Shell.OnLoaded from App.Host.Services
properties.layout: single Page hosting one three-column workspace grid; no navigation frame

properties.columnBehavior: Shell.SyncRailsAnimation snaps LeftRailColumn/RightRailColumn Width between 0 and 280 px; comment states Grid columns do not smoothly re-measure under DoubleAnimation on Skia desktop

properties.purpose: Lists the eight layers with per-layer state reflected in left-border color and opacity (class doc)
properties.refresh: re-renders on DataContext PropertyChanged for ActiveIndex or LayerStates

nodes.name: Composition stack caption
nodes.text: A conversation that crystallizes into a build system.

properties.path: TextChanged → SetActivePrompt(text) → MarkDirty(activeKind) when the text is non-empty
Click in the Dirty state → GeneratePreview() → SetLayerState(kind, Previewing)
Click → DiscardEdits() → restore snapshot + SetLayerState(kind, Clean)
Click (or Esc in the prompt box) → DiscardPreview() → restore snapshot + SetLayerState(kind, Clean)
row Click → Jump(row.Index) → ShellModel.ActiveIndex changes → ActiveCanvas.SyncSlot replaces CanvasSlot.Content with the layer's canvas

evidence.rationale: Both ends are declared: OnLayerRowClick invokes the Jump command and ActiveCanvas subscribes to ActiveIndex/ActiveLayer changes to swap CanvasSlot.Content.

properties.path: RevisitButton Click → Revisit(LayerKind) → ShellModel jumps to that layer index → SyncSlot replaces CanvasSlot.Content

evidence.rationale: OnRevisitClick invokes the declared Revisit command, which ShellModel implements as a Jump to the layer index; the canvas slot re-renders on the resulting ActiveIndex change.

unresolved.question: CompositionStack.xaml declares ItemsRepeater ItemsSource="{Binding Layers}", but the code-behind unconditionally overwrites ItemsSource with projected LayerRow items and no Layers member was found on ComposerModel/ShellModel. Is the XAML binding dead markup?
unresolved.reason: The declared binding path could not be resolved to a model member; the rendered rows demonstrably come from code-behind.

unresolved.question: The shell hardcodes 0:0:0.48 / 0:0:0.32 / 0:0:0.24 / 480 ms and inline QuinticEase instances, while Themes/Tokens.xaml declares Duration.Quick/Standard/Expressive/Slow and named easing keys. Should the motion tokens here be the declared resource keys, or is the literal set intentional?
possibleValues: literals are intentional (480 ms has no declared equivalent)
should resolve to Duration.Expressive (0:0:0.4) and an easing key
unresolved.reason: Both readings are supported by the source; the graph records the literal values actually consumed.

unresolved.question: CharacterSpacing 160 (and 180 on the kbd hint) recurs across nearly every mono TextBlock on this surface without any declared resource. Is it a design token or an inherited literal?
unresolved.reason: The MonoEyebrow style declares 180; the inline mono TextBlocks write 160, so a single tracking rule cannot be asserted.

unresolved.question: AppTitleRow is instantiated with Visibility="Collapsed" and a comment saying it was hidden on 2026-05-12, yet its DP bindings and Reset command remain wired. Is it part of the intended surface or retired scaffolding?
unresolved.reason: Declared but never rendered; keeping it in the graph as collapsed rather than deleting or asserting it is visible.

unresolved.question: Shell.xaml comments describe a "Stack canvas, ActiveIndex=0" cold-launch layer, but LayerKind has no Stack member and Layers.All[0] is Intent. Do the rails' first-screen rules key off Intent rather than a Stack layer?
unresolved.reason: Comments and code disagree; the graph follows the code (RailsVisible = LockedLayers.Count > 0 || ActiveIndex > 0, eight layers starting at Intent).

unresolved.question: Both Shell.xaml and ActiveCanvas.xaml.cs state the center column is intended to become a uen:Region.Attached navigation surface, with Pages + RouteMap kept as scaffolding. Should the canvas slot be modeled as a navigation region in a later pass?
unresolved.reason: Modeled as direct content hosting because that is what the code implements today.

unresolved.question: FilesRail's class doc and FileStatus.Writing both describe a pulsing indigo dot, but no pulse animation is declared in FilesRail.xaml or its code-behind.
unresolved.reason: Documented intent without an implementation; the state records only the declared static presentation.

metadata.scopeBoundary: Shell surface only. The eight per-layer canvases under Views/Layers/ (and the chip/icon dictionaries serving them) are excluded; region.active-canvas.canvas-slot marks where they mount.
metadata.componentInternalsPolicy: Repeated, data-driven components (layer-item, file-item, locked-context-card, future-preview-card, suggestion-chip) record their internals as properties.parts per the canonical-internals rule; singleton composite UserControls (composition-stack, active-canvas, files-rail, composer-footer, progress-indicator, app-title-row, active-layer-header) carry child control/content nodes per the Pass 2 hierarchy.
metadata.instancePolicy: No instance nodes: every repetition on this surface is data-driven from Composer.Models.Layers.All or FileRow/LayerRow projections, so instances carry no distinct design identity; counts are recorded on the canonical nodes instead.
metadata.tokenPolicy: Tokens cover only values this surface consumes. Themes/ChipStyles.xaml, ContextEngineStyles.xaml, Icons.xaml, PlatformChip.xaml and RuntimeChip.xaml were read for the style keys this surface references (InkButtonStyle, AmberButtonStyle, LinkButtonStyle, ChatInputTextBoxStyle, StackRowButtonStyle) — those are preserved as properties.uno.styleKey rather than tokenized, and the phase/state tint palettes, spacing/radius/duration keys the shell never references were left out.
metadata.styleInternalsExcluded: StackRowButtonStyle's PointerOver (Paper3Brush) and Pressed (opacity 0.85) visuals are control-template internals and are excluded from both tokens and states per the state-altitude and variant-folding rules.
